comment: Context-free translations for the closed GCG24 source surface; every visible binder, source condition, optimizer quantifier, support clause, and corrected center branch is retained. Proposition 2 was retranslated on 2026-07-29 after its full source-facing interface acquired the equality-defined utility-row type condition.

appendix_c_lemma1_item_fairness_positive.tex_statement: For a nonempty finite recommendation model with strictly positive utilities, the optimal item-fairness value is strictly positive.
appendix_c_lemma1_item_fairness_positive.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_d_lemma3_unconstrained_baseline.tex_statement: For a nonempty finite recommendation model with nonnegative utilities and a positive item in every user row, optimal user fairness at item-fairness level zero equals one.
appendix_d_lemma3_unconstrained_baseline.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_d_lemma8_selected_pivot_stitchi.tex_statement: For positive strictly decreasing item values and two first-half alpha values with alpha<=alpha', optimal item fairness for the two-type reduced model is weakly increasing from alpha to alpha'.
appendix_d_lemma8_selected_pivot_stitchi.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_d_lemma9_pair_share_algebra.tex_statement: For 0<alpha<alpha'<1 and positive strictly decreasing item values, pair share at a fixed item strictly increases with alpha and strictly decreases with the item index.
appendix_d_lemma9_pair_share_algebra.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_e_lemma12_symmetrized_policy.tex_statement: A supplied optimal policy for the estimated three-type model can be symmetrized without losing item-fairness optimality, and the resulting policy is mirror symmetric.
appendix_e_lemma12_symmetrized_policy.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_e_lemma16_midpoint_order_algebr.tex_statement: For positive strictly decreasing item values, a midpoint pair share is above, below, or equal to one half according as the item is before, after, or at its mirror.
appendix_e_lemma16_midpoint_order_algebr.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

itemFairness.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) = EconCSLib.finiteMin (normalizedItemUtility W ρ)
itemFairness.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

itemNormalizer.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} (W : RecommendationModel m n) (j : Item n) = \sum u, W.utility u j
itemNormalizer.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

normalizedItemUtility.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) (j : Item n) = rawItemUtility W ρ j / itemNormalizer W j
normalizedItemUtility.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

normalizedUserUtility.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) (u : User m) = rawUserUtility W ρ u / RecommendationModel.bestItemUtility W u
normalizedUserUtility.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

priceOfFairness.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n) = priceOfFairnessAt W 1
priceOfFairness.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

priceOfFairnessAt.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n) (\gamma : ℝ) = (RecommendationModel.optimalUserFairnessAtLevel W 0 - RecommendationModel.optimalUserFairnessAtLevel W \gamma) / RecommendationModel.optimalUserFairnessAtLevel W 0

priceOfMisestimation.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (E : EstimatedRecommendationModel m n) (\gamma : ℝ) (ρhat : Policy m n) = (RecommendationModel.optimalUserFairnessAtLevel E.trueModel \gamma - RecommendationModel.userFairness E.trueModel ρhat) / RecommendationModel.optimalUserFairnessAtLevel E.trueModel \gamma
priceOfMisestimation.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

proposition1_symmetric_lp_reduction.tex_statement: Proposition 1: if a policy set S has a finite linear description, rho* solves Problem (2), rho* belongs to S, and rho* is the unique policy in S attaining maximal item fairness, then the equality-form LP is feasible at rho*, every feasible LP value is at most the optimal item-fairness value, and every LP optimum recovers rho* and that value.
proposition1_symmetric_lp_reduction.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

proposition2_symmetric_optimum_exists.tex_statement: Proposition 2 (source-facing formalization). Let m, n, and K be nonzero finite cardinalities. Let S be a finite recommendation model with strictly positive utilities, a surjective assignment of users to K declared types, and the convention that two users have the same declared type exactly when their complete utility rows agree. For a user policy rho_src and real LP value ell satisfying the source equality-LP basic-feasible condition: (i) for every policy rho, rho gives equal recommendation probabilities to every pair of users with equal utility rows if and only if it satisfies every displayed finite type-pair equality constraint; (ii) an item-fairness-optimal utility-row-symmetric policy exists; (iii) the descended type policy from rho_src has at most n + K - 1 positive type-item pairs; and (iv) if ell equals the reduced equality-LP optimal item-fairness value, that descended policy has at most K - 1 items assigned positive probability by more than one type.
proposition2_symmetric_optimum_exists.translator: Codex GCG24 Proposition 2 current source-facing reattestation

rawItemUtility.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) (j : Item n) = \sum u, W.utility u j * (ρ u j).toReal
rawItemUtility.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

rawUserUtility.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) (u : User m) = EconCSLib.Policy.agentScore ρ W.utility u
rawUserUtility.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

recommendationUtility.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} (W : RecommendationModel m n) (u : User m) (j : Item n) = W.utility u j
recommendationUtility.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

theorem3_price_decreases_first_half.tex_statement: For the opposing two-type source model with positive strictly decreasing item values and 0 < alpha <= alpha' <= 1/2, increasing alpha toward the balanced population weakly decreases the price of fairness.
theorem3_price_decreases_first_half.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

theorem3_price_increases_second_half.tex_statement: For the opposing two-type source model with positive strictly decreasing item values and 1/2 <= alpha <= alpha' < 1, increasing alpha away from the balanced population weakly increases the price of fairness.
theorem3_price_increases_second_half.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

theorem4_misestimation_tradeoff_typeOne.tex_statement: \forall {m n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m] [inst_1 : NeZero n] (E : EstimatedRecommendationModel m n) (Rtrue : ReductionWitness m n 2) (Rest : ReductionWitness m n 3) (repsTrue : TypeRepresentatives types) (repsEst : TypeRepresentatives types) {beta eps : ℝ} (u : User m), 2 < n \to trueModel = model \to estimatedModel = model \to reduced = twoTypeReducedModel (1 / 2) (theorem4SmallValueVector eps) \to reduced = theorem4EstimatedReducedModel beta (theorem4SmallValueVector eps) \to (\forall (u : User m), toType u = 0 \to toType u = 0) \to (\forall (u : User m), toType u = 1 \to toType u = 1) \to toType u = 1 \to toType u = 2 \to 0 < eps \to (↑n)⁻¹ < beta \to beta < 1 / 2 \to (have ρ0 := theorem4NoFairnessPolicyCollapsed (theorem4SmallValueVector eps); SolvesEstimatedProblem 0 (liftedPolicy ρ0) \land priceOfMisestimation 0 (liftedPolicy ρ0) \le 1 / 2) \land \exists ρ1, SolvesEstimatedProblem 1 (liftedPolicy ρ1) \land 1 - eps < priceOfMisestimation 1 (liftedPolicy ρ1)
theorem4_misestimation_tradeoff_typeOne.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

theorem4_misestimation_tradeoff_typeZero.tex_statement: \forall {m n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m] [inst_1 : NeZero n] (E : EstimatedRecommendationModel m n) (Rtrue : ReductionWitness m n 2) (Rest : ReductionWitness m n 3) (repsTrue : TypeRepresentatives types) (repsEst : TypeRepresentatives types) {beta eps : ℝ} (u : User m), 2 < n \to trueModel = model \to estimatedModel = model \to reduced = twoTypeReducedModel (1 / 2) (theorem4SmallValueVector eps) \to reduced = theorem4EstimatedReducedModel beta (theorem4SmallValueVector eps) \to (\forall (u : User m), toType u = 0 \to toType u = 0) \to (\forall (u : User m), toType u = 1 \to toType u = 1) \to toType u = 0 \to toType u = 2 \to 0 < eps \to (↑n)⁻¹ < beta \to beta < 1 / 2 \to (have ρ0 := theorem4NoFairnessPolicyCollapsed (theorem4SmallValueVector eps); SolvesEstimatedProblem 0 (liftedPolicy ρ0) \land priceOfMisestimation 0 (liftedPolicy ρ0) \le 1 / 2) \land \exists ρ1, SolvesEstimatedProblem 1 (liftedPolicy ρ1) \land 1 - eps < priceOfMisestimation 1 (liftedPolicy ρ1)
theorem4_misestimation_tradeoff_typeZero.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_d_lemma4_problem6_unique_sparse.tex_statement: For a nonempty finite item set, 0 < alpha < 1, and positive strictly decreasing item values, there exist a pivot t, an equalized globally optimal Problem 6 policy rho*, and value lambda*. The type-zero support ends at t, the type-one support begins at t, and every other equalized globally optimal policy/value pair equals (rho*, lambda*).
appendix_d_lemma4_problem6_unique_sparse.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_d_lemma5_problem6_active_optimi.tex_statement: For a nonempty finite item set, 0 < alpha < 1, and positive strictly decreasing values, there exists the unique equalized globally optimal Problem 6 policy rho* with value lambda*. At its last active type-zero item t, lambda* is the closed value; type-zero coordinates are lambda*/q_j left of t, the displayed residual at t, and zero right of t, while type-one coordinates are zero left of t, the displayed residual at t, and lambda*/(1-q_j) right of t.
appendix_d_lemma5_problem6_active_optimi.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_d_lemma6_optimal_policy_type_ut.tex_statement: For 0 < alpha < 1/2 and positive strictly decreasing item values, the normalized utility of source type 0 under the unique optimal Problem 6 policy is at least the normalized utility of source type 1.
appendix_d_lemma6_optimal_policy_type_ut.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_d_lemma7_active_optimizer_pivot.tex_statement: For positive strictly decreasing values and 0 < alpha <= alpha' < 1, the last active type-zero index of the unique Problem 6 optimizer at alpha is at most the corresponding index at alpha'.
appendix_d_lemma7_active_optimizer_pivot.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_d_lemma10_active_optimizer_pivo.tex_statement: For 0 < alpha <= 1/2 and positive strictly decreasing values, the active pivot t of the unique Problem 6 optimizer satisfies t <= reverseItem(t), equivalently t is at or before the item midpoint.
appendix_d_lemma10_active_optimizer_pivo.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_d_lemma11_optimal_item_fairness.tex_statement: For positive strictly decreasing values and 0 < alpha <= alpha' < 1, if the unique Problem 6 optimizers at alpha and alpha' have the same pivot t and t is at or before the midpoint, then optimal item fairness at alpha is at most optimal item fairness at alpha'.
appendix_d_lemma11_optimal_item_fairness.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_e_lemma13_every_optimal_basic_s.tex_statement: For n > 2, 1/n < beta < 1/2, and positive strictly decreasing values, every mirror-symmetric, item-equalized, globally optimal basic feasible Problem 11 policy rho has a pivot t at or before its mirror. Type zero is zero above t, and the cold-start type is zero at both j and reverseItem(j) below t.
appendix_e_lemma13_every_optimal_basic_s.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_e_lemma14_problem11_has_unique_.tex_statement: For n > 2, 1/n < beta < 1/2, and positive strictly decreasing values, there exists a mirror-symmetric, item-equalized globally optimal Problem 11 policy rho* and value lambda*, and every other mirror-symmetric globally optimal feasible policy/value pair equals (rho*, lambda*).
appendix_e_lemma14_problem11_has_unique_.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_e_lemma15_optimal_solution_full.tex_statement: For n > 2, 1/n < beta < 1/2, positive strictly decreasing values, and any mirror-symmetric item-equalized globally optimal Problem 11 policy rho with value lambda, let t be its last active type-zero item. Then t is at or before its mirror; all type-zero and cold-start coordinates have the displayed left, pivot, interior, and zero formulas. If t is before its mirror, lambda and both pivot cold-start coordinates have the printed noncenter formulas. If t is the center, the cold-start coordinate is one and lambda = 1/(1+L_t).
appendix_e_lemma15_optimal_solution_full.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_e_lemma15_printed_center_value_.tex_statement: The source-domain values n=3, beta=2/5, q_t=1/2, and L_t=4/3 satisfy 1/n < beta < 1/2, and the corrected center value 1/(1+L_t) is unequal to the printed center expression (2 beta q_t + 1 - 2 beta)/(1+q_t L_t).
appendix_e_lemma15_printed_center_value_.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_e_lemma17_every_optimal_solutio.tex_statement: For n > 2, 1/n < beta < 1/2, positive strictly decreasing values, and every mirror-symmetric item-equalized globally optimal Problem 11 policy rho, each item j strictly after its mirror has rho's type-zero coordinate equal to zero.
appendix_e_lemma17_every_optimal_solutio.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit

appendix_c_lemma2_item_fairness_equality.tex_statement: For a finite nonempty recommendation model with strictly positive utilities, a policy maximizes the original minimum normalized item utility if and only if it is the policy component of an optimal solution to the equality-form LP: some common level ell is attained at every item and no equality-form feasible policy can attain a larger level.
appendix_c_lemma2_item_fairness_equality.translator: Codex GCG24 source-first v10 closeout audit
